##### Project general facts

Zephyra Residences by Arsenal East is a premium waterfront development of two contemporary buildings set within a calm island setting. Cascading balconies inspired by sand dunes create a striking facade that blends with the natural landscape. Each building rises above parking levels to ten residential floors, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom duplexes, townhouses and three-bedroom penthouses, catering to a wide range of lifestyles from couples to growing families.

Residents enjoy an infinity pool with a relaxation area, a modern gym with the latest equipment and a dedicated yoga and meditation space for a balanced routine. A children's play area and splash zone, landscaped gardens, green areas and walking paths create calm places to unwind, while elegant lobbies, concierge services, lifts, parking and impeccably maintained common areas underline the atmosphere of refined island living for residents and their guests.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, and kitchens feature modern Porcelanosa fittings and premium SMEG appliances. Apartments are styled with a minimalist approach, while two- and three-bedroom homes receive a richer design and townhouses add glass and granite accents. Buyers can choose between fully furnished homes and semi-furnished homes with fitted kitchens and appliances, completing the space with their own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront master community of five man-made islands off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods, resorts, marinas and long stretches of public beach. Landscaped promenades, parks and cycling paths run along the shoreline, while hotels, beach clubs and waterfront dining venues give the islands a relaxed resort character close to the historic heart of the city.

The Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with Deira, Bur Dubai and the city centre. Dubai Islands Beach, the Waterfront Market and the Gold Souk are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for furnished waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
